# Backdrop

Overlay that can be used to shade the background

## Overview

- **Category**: feedback
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: Backdrop

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { Backdrop } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<Backdrop open={true}>
  <CircularProgress color="inherit" />
</Backdrop>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<Backdrop open={true}>
  <CircularProgress color="inherit" />
</Backdrop>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's Backdrop.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI Backdrop Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/backdrop/)
